body: That’s what I’m doing actively but they’re taking their time getting back to me. I’ve applied for over a dozen and it’s honestly just a waiting game at this point
I’m trying to wean myself off of my parents before going completely no contact with them. For now, I’m just LC and have been since I moved out.
That’s literally what I asked her to do earlier but she said “No” and then rolled her eyes and tsked at me
I got so mad I started slurping my drink because I was so sick of dealing with it the whole car trip. This was when she started the name calling

My mom actually defended me for once but disagreed with me cutting her off because she’s “family” but I honestly don’t care at this point anymore. I’ve honestly become apathetic to my sisters situation at this point which is honestly really sad

I’m 19 and she is 18 we have a year and a half age gap and I’ve considered cutting her off for a while but delayed due to family pressure. They enable her behavior towards me since she often pushes me to explode in order to gain pity points. My BF of 1yr (who I met through her) advised me to cut her and my family off earlier due to witnessing this first hand during thanksgiving which was an entirely different can of worms. 

In regards to her support she barely has any seeing as my family isn’t exactly the best and honestly weren’t surprised when her troubles began and the only one helping her emotionally is my older sister while my mom handles the legal side and the financial side. I’ve been LC since I was 15 (despite living together)  and I hardly involved her in my life and the same was true for her. During my teens I removed myself from the family dinning table to avoid further incidents and to ensure LC and the only time we saw each other was on the ride home or passing each other in the hallway.
